acceptance_proof: FrameType/code/f_back/locals and exact original field/nested anchors, not IDs alone.
callback_scope: Original port methods and admission/selection/result callbacks retain current identities.
hook_limits: Test-local assertions and serialization inspect existing objects. No derives, transforms, decoders, policy callbacks, frame replacements, tracing, profiling, or other-thread inspection occur in the hook.
local_partial_frame_record: Original actual completion FrameType retains original partial objects.
local_results: Existing separate local-result registry remains empty. CompressionFrame has no local_result field.
method_scope: All original dispatch, completion, decode, transformation, derive, snapshot, retention, acceptance, and invalidation methods retain their identities.
payload_contract: Each final-row payload is local payload. Each final-row handle is local content. Parent tuple containers need no identity.
response_contract: message.tool_calls remains None. Canonical wire projection omits this non-wire field.
updated_pending_frame_record: Original retention methods produce a distinct updated frame and accept its completed invocation exactly once.
